plans.caveats: Kiro bills per request/credit not per token and publishes no token or dollar conversion; the 3.1 credits/M slope comes from one third-party test with uncached first-call inputs, assumes cache reads count as full tokens (conservative; if Kiro discounts cache, value is higher), and the 1.1 output weighting is assumed. Uncertainty roughly +-40%. Previous x2.0 (add-on $0.04 vs $0.02) was wrong because $0.04 is a retail overage price, not API cost; uncached list cost per credit measured at ~$0.50-0.70. Fable 5.1 is Enterprise-preview only and excluded. Amazon Q Developer Pro closed.
plans.default_basis: One API-$-per-credit value per model, identical on every tier (all tiers = $0.02/included credit, so same multiplier). Classmethod metered single-request runs in Kiro CLI: Sonnet 5 0.82/1.80/2.10 credits for 189K/435K/506K input tokens (3.98 credits/M slope, ~0.07 fixed); Opus 5 1.40/3.07/3.57 for 190K/435K/506K (6.9/M); Auto 0.61/1.39/1.61 for 188K/434K/505K (3.2/M). So credits are ~linear in tokens at ~3.1 credits/M tokens per 1.0x. Value per credit = brief cache-heavy mix $/M (90% cache read at 10% of input, 7.5% fresh, 2.5% output) / (3.1 x multiplier x 1.1 [output weighting]). Sonnet 5.5: $0.58/M / 4.43 = $0.131/credit = 6.5x the $0.02 included rate. Default shown = Sonnet 5.5; Opus 5.5 8.5x.

models.basis: 2.0x multiplier = 6.2 credits/M tokens; cache-heavy mix $1.16/M (Opus 5.5 $4/$20) / 6.82 credits (x1.1 output weighting) = $0.17/credit; /$0.02 = 8.5.
models.name: Claude Opus 5.5

models.basis: 2.2x = 6.82 credits/M; mix $0.63/M (Terra $2/$12) / 7.5 credits = $0.084/credit; /$0.02 = 4.2. Burn multiplier extrapolated, not measured; excludes >272K requests (double rate).
models.name: GPT-5.6 Terra

models.basis: 2.4x = 7.44 credits/M; mix $0.87/M (K3 $3/$15) / 8.18 credits = $0.106/credit; /$0.02 = 5.3. Extrapolated, not measured.
models.name: Kimi K3

models.basis: Kiro bills at least 0.01 credit per request; a ~50k-token cache-heavy call at 0.05× would cost ~0.008 credit, so the floor binds: $0.0037 of list-price tokens per $0.0002 credit = ×18.

plans.default_basis: Assumption: a heavy-but-realistic user fully burns one 5-hour window every other day (15 windows/month; no community window-count data found). 40 prompts × 15 = 600 prompts × 15 calls × 45,000 tokens = 0.41B tokens × $0.250/M (KAT-Coder-Pro V2.5: ¥5 in / ¥20 out / ¥1 cache read per 1M) = $101 ÷ $5.00 = x20.2. Rescaled ×2.22 to the common 100k tokens per model call used for every request-counted plan (Volcengine Ark: ~60k/call over 5,000 calls; Claude Code logs: ~190k/call; committed 100k).

plans.default_basis: Weekly 60M input tokens = 97.5% of all tokens in the brief mix (90% cache reads + 7.5% fresh), so total 61.54M/week: 55.38M cache reads, 4.62M fresh, 1.54M output. Monthly = x30/7. Value per model = 4.2857 x (55.38 x 0.1p_in + 4.62 p_in + 1.54 p_out), i.e. M = 3.626 p_in + 0.550 p_out (list $/1M, divided by $12).
